## CommonMark corners

Edge cases from everyday CommonMark: emphasis, references, rules, and quotes.

## Emphasis and code

Single stars and double stars become plain words. So do underlines and strikes. A code span with backtick inside reads as words.

A reference link points here without speaking the URL.

Autolinks like vanish from speech.

AT&T keeps its entity. 3.14 stays exact.

Nested quotes

unwrap twice.

Ordered lists keep their order.

Starting numbers are not spoken.

The letters a, b, and c stay lowercase. Done.
